{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01JcVDQ6GJe351QC7Q6GgMF3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_01JgF666zuLrh2EwV76LbDz8","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/pytesseract-ocr.md","content":"# Pytesseract OCR\n\n## Overview\nPytesseract is a Python wrapper for Google's Tesseract-OCR Engine. It enables text extraction from images and is particularly useful for processing scanned documents, receipts, and other text-based images.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\n# Install Tesseract OCR engine\nsudo apt-get install tesseract-ocr\n\n# Install Python wrapper\npip install pytesseract\n```\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Simple Text Extraction\n```python\nimport pytesseract\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n# Read image\nimage = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Extract text\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image)\nprint(text)\n```\n\n### With Configuration Options\n```python\n# Custom configuration for better accuracy\ncustom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, config=custom_config)\n```\n\n### PSM (Page Segmentation Mode) Options\n- `--psm 3`: Fully automatic page segmentation (default)\n- `--psm 4`: Assume a single column of text of variable sizes\n- `--psm 6`: Assume a single uniform block of text\n- `--psm 11`: Sparse text. Find as much text as possible in no particular order\n\n### OEM (OCR Engine Mode) Options\n- `--oem 0`: Legacy engine only\n- `--oem 1`: Neural nets LSTM engine only\n- `--oem 2`: Legacy + LSTM engines\n- `--oem 3`: Default, based on what is available\n\n## Image Preprocessing for Better OCR\n\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"Preprocess image for better OCR results\"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Increase contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n# Use preprocessed image\npreprocessed = preprocess_image('receipt.jpg')\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed)\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n1. **Preprocess images**: Convert to grayscale, adjust contrast, remove noise\n2. **Choose appropriate PSM**: Use PSM 6 for receipts (single block of text)\n3. **Handle orientation**: Rotate images if text is not horizontal\n4. **Language specification**: Use `lang` parameter if text is not in English\n5. **Error handling**: Always wrap OCR calls in try-except blocks\n\n## Common Issues\n- Poor image quality: Increase resolution or enhance contrast\n- Skewed text: Use image rotation/deskewing\n- Multiple languages: Specify language with `lang='eng+fra'`\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"cache_creation_input_tokens":701,"cache_read_input_tokens":19670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":701,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"7052d2bd-59b8-4219-9a40-b8ca162556db"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01JcVDQ6GJe351QC7Q6GgMF3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_019V2GDEcExaaHPLLyf9o3W2","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/regex-text-parsing.md","content":"# Regular Expressions for Text Parsing\n\n## Overview\nRegular expressions (regex) are powerful patterns used for matching and extracting text from strings. Essential for parsing OCR output, receipts, and unstructured text data.\n\n## Python re Module\n\n```python\nimport re\n```\n\n## Common Patterns\n\n### Extracting Numbers\n```python\n# Integer\npattern = r'\\d+'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total: 123\")\n# Result: '123'\n\n# Decimal number\npattern = r'\\d+\\.\\d{2}'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Amount: 45.99\")\n# Result: '45.99'\n\n# Number with optional comma separator\npattern = r'\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total: 1,234.56\")\n# Result: '1,234.56'\n```\n\n### Date Extraction\n```python\n# DD/MM/YYYY format\npattern = r'\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4}'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Date: 25/01/2024\")\n\n# DD-MM-YYYY format\npattern = r'\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}'\n\n# Multiple formats\npattern = r'\\d{2}[/-]\\d{2}[/-]\\d{4}'\n```\n\n### Currency Amounts\n```python\n# Amount with currency symbol\npattern = r'RM\\s*(\\d+\\.\\d{2})'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total RM 45.50\")\namount = match.group(1)  # '45.50'\n\n# With optional comma separators\npattern = r'RM\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)'\n```\n\n## Useful Methods\n\n### re.search()\n```python\n# Find first occurrence\nmatch = re.search(r'TOTAL.*?(\\d+\\.\\d{2})', text)\nif match:\n    amount = match.group(1)\n```\n\n### re.findall()\n```python\n# Find all occurrences\namounts = re.findall(r'\\d+\\.\\d{2}', text)\n# Returns: ['12.50', '3.99', '45.00']\n```\n\n### re.sub()\n```python\n# Replace patterns\nclean_text = re.sub(r'[^\\d.]', '', \"RM 1,234.56\")\n# Result: '1234.56'\n```\n\n## Flags\n```python\n# Case insensitive\nre.search(r'total', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Multiline mode\nre.search(r'^TOTAL', text, re.MULTILINE)\n\n# Dot matches newline\nre.search(r'TOTAL.*?(\\d+)', text, re.DOTALL)\n```\n\n## Best Practices for Receipt Parsing\n\n### Extract Total Amount\n```python\ndef extract_total(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract total amount from receipt text\"\"\"\n    # Try different patterns in priority order\n    patterns = [\n        r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL[:\\s]*RM?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL\\s+RM[:\\s]*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT[:\\s]*RM?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL[:\\s]*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in patterns:\n        match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n        if match:\n            amount = match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n            return float(amount)\n\n    return None\n```\n\n### Extract Date\n```python\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract date from receipt text\"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    patterns = [\n        r'(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})',  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in patterns:\n        match = re.search(pattern, text)\n        if match:\n            return match.group(0)\n\n    return None\n```\n\n## Special Characters\n- `.` - Any character\n- `*` - Zero or more\n- `+` - One or more\n- `?` - Zero or one (also makes quantifiers non-greedy)\n- `\\d` - Digit [0-9]\n- `\\s` - Whitespace\n- `\\w` - Word character [a-zA-Z0-9_]\n- `[]` - Character class\n- `()` - Capture group\n- `(?:)` - Non-capturing group\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"cache_creation_input_tokens":701,"cache_read_input_tokens":19670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":701,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"0b2bac8e-26e7-4703-bb5c-e6f3e84ad766"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01JcVDQ6GJe351QC7Q6GgMF3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_01MidKsNLpnozppehaXYY1Qi","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/openpyxl-excel.md","content":"# OpenPyXL - Excel File Operations\n\n## Overview\nOpenPyXL is a Python library for reading and writing Excel 2010 xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm files. It provides comprehensive Excel manipulation capabilities without requiring Microsoft Excel.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\npip install openpyxl\n```\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Creating a New Workbook\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n# Create workbook\nwb = Workbook()\n\n# Get active sheet\nws = wb.active\n\n# Set sheet title\nws.title = \"results\"\n\n# Write data to cells\nws['A1'] = 'Name'\nws['B1'] = 'Age'\nws['C1'] = 'City'\n\n# Or use row/column notation (1-indexed)\nws.cell(row=2, column=1, value='Alice')\nws.cell(row=2, column=2, value=30)\nws.cell(row=2, column=3, value='New York')\n\n# Save workbook\nwb.save('output.xlsx')\n```\n\n### Writing Multiple Rows\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\nwb = Workbook()\nws = wb.active\n\n# Write header\nheaders = ['filename', 'date', 'total_amount']\nws.append(headers)\n\n# Write data rows\ndata = [\n    ['001.jpg', '2024-01-15', '45.50'],\n    ['002.jpg', '2024-01-16', '123.75'],\n    ['003.jpg', None, None],  # Null values\n]\n\nfor row in data:\n    ws.append(row)\n\nwb.save('results.xlsx')\n```\n\n### Reading Excel Files\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import load_workbook\n\n# Load existing workbook\nwb = load_workbook('input.xlsx')\n\n# Get sheet by name\nws = wb['Sheet1']\n\n# Read cell value\nvalue = ws['A1'].value\n\n# Iterate through rows\nfor row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):\n    filename, date, amount = row\n    print(f\"{filename}: {amount}\")\n```\n\n## Working with Sheets\n\n### Create/Delete Sheets\n```python\n# Create new sheet\nws1 = wb.create_sheet(\"Sheet2\")\n\n# Create at specific position\nws2 = wb.create_sheet(\"Sheet3\", 0)  # Insert at beginning\n\n# Delete sheet\ndel wb[\"Sheet3\"]\n\n# Get all sheet names\nprint(wb.sheetnames)\n```\n\n### Accessing Sheets\n```python\n# By name\nws = wb[\"results\"]\n\n# Active sheet\nws = wb.active\n\n# By index\nws = wb.worksheets[0]\n```\n\n## Data Types and Formatting\n\n### Writing Different Data Types\n```python\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nws['A1'] = 'Text'\nws['B1'] = 123  # Integer\nws['C1'] = 45.67  # Float\nws['D1'] = datetime.now()  # DateTime\nws['E1'] = True  # Boolean\nws['F1'] = None  # Null\n```\n\n### Number Formatting\n```python\nfrom openpyxl.styles import numbers\n\n# Format as currency\nws['A1'] = 45.50\nws['A1'].number_format = '\"$\"#,##0.00'\n\n# Format as percentage\nws['B1'] = 0.85\nws['B1'].number_format = '0.00%'\n\n# Custom format\nws['C1'].number_format = '0.00'\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### Efficient Row Writing\n```python\n# Efficient: Use append for multiple rows\ndata = [\n    ['row1_col1', 'row1_col2'],\n    ['row2_col1', 'row2_col2'],\n]\nfor row in data:\n    ws.append(row)\n\n# Less efficient: Individual cell writes\n# ws.cell(row=1, column=1, value='data')\n```\n\n### Handling Null Values\n```python\n# OpenPyXL handles None as empty cell\nws.append(['filename.jpg', None, '45.50'])\n# Result: filename.jpg | (empty) | 45.50\n```\n\n### Creating Clean Workbooks\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n# Create new workbook\nwb = Workbook()\n\n# Remove default sheet if needed\nif 'Sheet' in wb.sheetnames:\n    del wb['Sheet']\n\n# Create your sheet\nws = wb.create_sheet('results', 0)\n\n# Write data\nws.append(['Column1', 'Column2'])\n\nwb.save('clean_output.xlsx')\n```\n\n## Complete Example: Receipt Data to Excel\n\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\ndef save_receipts_to_excel(data, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        data: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01JcVDQ6GJe351QC7Q6GgMF3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_017VzHCDvphcb9sX3upqiddu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/datetime-parsing.md","content":"# DateTime Parsing and Formatting\n\n## Overview\nPython's datetime module provides classes for manipulating dates and times. Essential for parsing various date formats and converting them to standard formats like ISO 8601.\n\n## Installation\n```python\n# Built-in module, no installation needed\nfrom datetime import datetime, date\n```\n\n## Parsing Dates\n\n### Using datetime.strptime()\n```python\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Parse specific format\ndate_str = \"25/01/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d/%m/%Y\")\n\n# Convert to ISO format\niso_date = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n# Result: \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### Common Format Codes\n- `%d` - Day of month (01-31)\n- `%m` - Month (01-12)\n- `%Y` - Year (4 digits)\n- `%y` - Year (2 digits)\n- `%B` - Full month name (January)\n- `%b` - Abbreviated month name (Jan)\n- `%A` - Full weekday name (Monday)\n- `%a` - Abbreviated weekday name (Mon)\n- `%H` - Hour 24-hour (00-23)\n- `%I` - Hour 12-hour (01-12)\n- `%M` - Minute (00-59)\n- `%S` - Second (00-59)\n- `%p` - AM/PM\n\n## Common Date Formats\n\n### DD/MM/YYYY\n```python\ndate_str = \"25/01/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d/%m/%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### DD-MM-YYYY\n```python\ndate_str = \"25-01-2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d-%m-%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### MM/DD/YYYY (US format)\n```python\ndate_str = \"01/25/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%m/%d/%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### YYYY-MM-DD (ISO format)\n```python\ndate_str = \"2024-01-25\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n# Already in ISO format\n```\n\n## Handling Multiple Formats\n\n### Try Multiple Patterns\n```python\ndef parse_date_flexible(date_str):\n    \"\"\"Try to parse date string with multiple formats\"\"\"\n    formats = [\n        \"%d/%m/%Y\",      # 25/01/2024\n        \"%d-%m-%Y\",      # 25-01-2024\n        \"%Y-%m-%d\",      # 2024-01-25\n        \"%m/%d/%Y\",      # 01/25/2024\n        \"%d %b %Y\",      # 25 Jan 2024\n        \"%d %B %Y\",      # 25 January 2024\n        \"%B %d, %Y\",     # January 25, 2024\n    ]\n\n    for fmt in formats:\n        try:\n            return datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n\n    return None  # No format matched\n```\n\n### Convert to ISO Format\n```python\ndef to_iso_date(date_str):\n    \"\"\"Convert various date formats to ISO YYYY-MM-DD\"\"\"\n    date_obj = parse_date_flexible(date_str)\n    if date_obj:\n        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    return None\n```\n\n## Date Validation\n\n### Check Valid Date\n```python\ndef is_valid_date(date_str, format_str=\"%d/%m/%Y\"):\n    \"\"\"Check if string is a valid date\"\"\"\n    try:\n        datetime.strptime(date_str, format_str)\n        return True\n    except ValueError:\n        return False\n```\n\n### Handle Edge Cases\n```python\n# Invalid date\ntry:\n    datetime.strptime(\"31/02/2024\", \"%d/%m/%Y\")\nexcept ValueError as e:\n    print(\"Invalid date\")  # February doesn't have 31 days\n```\n\n## Formatting Dates\n\n### Standard Formats\n```python\ndate_obj = datetime(2024, 1, 25)\n\n# ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n\n# US format (MM/DD/YYYY)\nus = date_obj.strftime(\"%m/%d/%Y\")   # \"01/25/2024\"\n\n# European format (DD/MM/YYYY)\neu = date_obj.strftime(\"%d/%m/%Y\")   # \"25/01/2024\"\n\n# Long format\nlong = date_obj.strftime(\"%B %d, %Y\")  # \"January 25, 2024\"\n```\n\n## Receipt Date Extraction Example\n\n```python\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\ndef extract_and_format_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt OCR text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Find date pattern\n    date_pattern = r'\\d{2}[/-]\\d{2}[/-]\\d{4}'\n    match = re.search(date_pattern, text)\n\n    if not match:\n        return None\n\n    date_str = match.group(0)\n\n    # Try different formats\n    formats = [\n        \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n        \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n        \"%m/%d/%Y\",\n        \"%m-%d-%Y\",\n    ]\n\n    for fmt in formats:\n        try:\n            date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n            # Convert to ISO format\n            return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n\n    return None\n\n# Usage\nocr_text = \"Date: 25/01/2024\\nTotal: RM 45.50\"\niso_date = extract_and_format_date(ocr_text)\nprint(iso_date)  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always validate dates** before formatting\n2. **Use try-except** when parsing unknown formats\n3. **Store dates in ISO format** for consistency\n4. **Be aware of locale** (US vs European date formats)\n5. **Handle timezone** if needed (use `pytz` or `zoneinfo`)\n\n## Common Pitfalls\n\n```python\n# Ambiguous dates\ndate_str = \"01/02/2024\"\n# Is this January 2nd or February 1st?\n# Always clarify the expected format\n\n# Two-digit years\ndatetime.strptime(\"25/01/24\", \"%d/%m/%y\")  # Assumes 2024, not 1924\n\n# Whitespace\ndate_str = \" 25/01/2024 \"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str.strip(), \"%d/%m/%Y\")  # Always strip\n```\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"cache_creation_input_tokens":701,"cache_read_input_tokens":19670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":701,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"5d53368e-90bc-4ba7-88b5-667bda884031"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01JcVDQ6GJe351QC7Q6GgMF3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_017HW9814PMhLa3uWnYB4Exx","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/pillow-image-processing.md","content":"# Pillow (PIL) - Image Processing\n\n## Overview\nPillow is the friendly PIL (Python Imaging Library) fork. It provides extensive file format support and powerful image processing capabilities, essential for preprocessing images before OCR.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\npip install Pillow\n```\n\n## Basic Image Operations\n\n### Opening and Saving Images\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n# Open image\nimg = Image.open('input.jpg')\n\n# Save image\nimg.save('output.png')\n\n# Save with quality\nimg.save('output.jpg', quality=95)\n```\n\n### Image Information\n```python\n# Get image properties\nprint(img.size)      # (width, height)\nprint(img.format)    # 'JPEG', 'PNG', etc.\nprint(img.mode)      # 'RGB', 'L' (grayscale), etc.\n\n# Check dimensions\nwidth, height = img.size\n```\n\n## Image Preprocessing for OCR\n\n### Convert to Grayscale\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nimg = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Convert to grayscale\ngray_img = img.convert('L')\ngray_img.save('gray_receipt.jpg')\n```\n\n### Enhance Contrast\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance\n\nimg = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Increase contrast\nenhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\nenhanced_img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)  # 1.0 is original, >1.0 increases contrast\n```\n\n### Adjust Brightness\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageEnhance\n\nenhancer = ImageEnhance.Brightness(img)\nbrighter_img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)  # 1.5x brighter\n```\n\n### Sharpen Image\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageFilter\n\n# Apply sharpening filter\nsharpened = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n# Or unsharp mask for more control\nsharpened = img.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=2, percent=150))\n```\n\n### Resize Image\n```python\n# Resize to specific dimensions\nnew_size = (800, 600)\nresized = img.resize(new_size)\n\n# Resize maintaining aspect ratio\nimg.thumbnail((800, 800))  # Max dimensions, maintains ratio\n```\n\n### Rotate Image\n```python\n# Rotate by angle (counter-clockwise)\nrotated = img.rotate(90, expand=True)  # expand=True adjusts canvas size\n\n# Auto-rotate based on EXIF\nfrom PIL import ImageOps\ncorrected = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img)\n```\n\n## Complete Preprocessing Pipeline\n\n### For Receipt OCR\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\n\ndef preprocess_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    # Open image\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    # Optional: Apply threshold for black & white\n    # img = img.point(lambda x: 0 if x < 128 else 255, '1')\n\n    return img\n\n# Usage with pytesseract\nimport pytesseract\n\npreprocessed = preprocess_receipt('receipt.jpg')\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed)\n```\n\n## Image Filters\n\n### Common Filters\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageFilter\n\n# Blur\nblurred = img.filter(ImageFilter.BLUR)\n\n# Gaussian blur\ngaussian = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=2))\n\n# Edge detection\nedges = img.filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES)\n\n# Smooth\nsmooth = img.filter(ImageFilter.SMOOTH)\n\n# Detail enhancement\ndetail = img.filter(ImageFilter.DETAIL)\n```\n\n## Working with Image Regions\n\n### Crop Image\n```python\n# Define box (left, top, right, bottom)\nbox = (100, 100, 400, 400)\ncropped = img.crop(box)\n```\n\n### Paste Image\n```python\n# Paste one image onto another\nbackground.paste(foreground, (x, y))\n```\n\n## Color Modes\n\n### Common Modes\n- `'1'` - 1-bit pixels, black and white\n- `'L'` - 8-bit pixels, grayscale\n- `'RGB'` - 3x8-bit pixels, true color\n- `'RGBA'` - 4x8-bit pixels, true color with transparency\n- `'CMYK'` - 4x8-bit pixels, color separation\n\n### Convert Between Modes\n```python\n# RGB to grayscale\ngray = rgb_img.convert('L')\n\n# Grayscale to RGB\nrgb = gray_img.convert('RGB')\n\n# To black & white (binary)\nbw = img.convert('1')\n```\n\n## File Format Handling\n\n### Read Different Formats\n```python\n# Pillow supports many formats\njpg_img = Image.open('image.jpg')\npng_img = Image.open('image.png')\nbmp_img = Image.open('image.bmp')\ntiff_img = Image.open('image.tiff')\n```\n\n### List All Files in Directory\n```python\nimport os\nfrom PIL import Image\n\ndef process_all_images(directory):\n    \"\"\"Process all images in directory\"\"\"\n    for filename in os.listdir(directory):\n        if filename.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')):\n            img_path = os.path.join(directory, filename)\n            img = Image.open(img_path)\n            # Process image...\n```\n\n## Best Practices for OCR Preprocessing\n\n1. **Convert to grayscale** - Reduces complexity, improves OCR accuracy\n2. **Increase contrast** - Makes text more distinguishable from background\n3. **Sharpen** - Clarifies text edges\n4. **Resize appropriately** - Too small reduces accuracy, too large slows processing\n5. **Remove noise** - Use filters to clean up image\n6. **Correct orientation** - Ensure text is horizontal\n\n## Memory Management\n\n```python\n# Close image when done\nimg.close()\n\n# Or use context manager\nwith Image.open('image.jpg') as img:\n    # Process image\n    processed = img.convert('L')\n# Image automatically closed\n```\n\n## Common Gotchas\n\n1. **Modification creates new image** - Most operations return new Image object\n2. **File formats have limitations** - JPEG doesn't support transparency\n3. **Color mode matters** - Some operations require specific modes\n4. **Filter order matters** - Apply filters in optimal sequence\n5. **EXIF data** - Remember to handle image rotation from EXIF\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"cache_creation_input_tokens":701,"cache_read_input_tokens":19670,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":701,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"3ed6f0da-7d73-4ff6-b83a-6f86109aa140"}

It enables text extraction from images and is particularly useful for processing scanned documents, receipts, and other text-based images.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\n# Install Tesseract OCR engine\nsudo apt-get install tesseract-ocr\n\n# Install Python wrapper\npip install pytesseract\n```\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Simple Text Extraction\n```python\nimport pytesseract\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n# Read image\nimage = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Extract text\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image)\nprint(text)\n```\n\n### With Configuration Options\n```python\n# Custom configuration for better accuracy\ncustom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(image, config=custom_config)\n```\n\n### PSM (Page Segmentation Mode) Options\n- `--psm 3`: Fully automatic page segmentation (default)\n- `--psm 4`: Assume a single column of text of variable sizes\n- `--psm 6`: Assume a single uniform block of text\n- `--psm 11`: Sparse text. Find as much text as possible in no particular order\n\n### OEM (OCR Engine Mode) Options\n- `--oem 0`: Legacy engine only\n- `--oem 1`: Neural nets LSTM engine only\n- `--oem 2`: Legacy + LSTM engines\n- `--oem 3`: Default, based on what is available\n\n## Image Preprocessing for Better OCR\n\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"Preprocess image for better OCR results\"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Increase contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n# Use preprocessed image\npreprocessed = preprocess_image('receipt.jpg')\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed)\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n1. **Preprocess images**: Convert to grayscale, adjust contrast, remove noise\n2. **Choose appropriate PSM**: Use PSM 6 for receipts (single block of text)\n3. **Handle orientation**: Rotate images if text is not horizontal\n4. **Language specification**: Use `lang` parameter if text is not in English\n5. **Error handling**: Always wrap OCR calls in try-except blocks\n\n## Common Issues\n- Poor image quality: Increase resolution or enhance contrast\n- Skewed text: Use image rotation/deskewing\n- Multiple languages: Specify language with `lang='eng+fra'`\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}

Essential for parsing OCR output, receipts, and unstructured text data.\n\n## Python re Module\n\n```python\nimport re\n```\n\n## Common Patterns\n\n### Extracting Numbers\n```python\n# Integer\npattern = r'\\d+'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total: 123\")\n# Result: '123'\n\n# Decimal number\npattern = r'\\d+\\.\\d{2}'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Amount: 45.99\")\n# Result: '45.99'\n\n# Number with optional comma separator\npattern = r'\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total: 1,234.56\")\n# Result: '1,234.56'\n```\n\n### Date Extraction\n```python\n# DD/MM/YYYY format\npattern = r'\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4}'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Date: 25/01/2024\")\n\n# DD-MM-YYYY format\npattern = r'\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}'\n\n# Multiple formats\npattern = r'\\d{2}[/-]\\d{2}[/-]\\d{4}'\n```\n\n### Currency Amounts\n```python\n# Amount with currency symbol\npattern = r'RM\\s*(\\d+\\.\\d{2})'\nmatch = re.search(pattern, \"Total RM 45.50\")\namount = match.group(1)  # '45.50'\n\n# With optional comma separators\npattern = r'RM\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)'\n```\n\n## Useful Methods\n\n### re.search()\n```python\n# Find first occurrence\nmatch = re.search(r'TOTAL.*?(\\d+\\.\\d{2})', text)\nif match:\n    amount = match.group(1)\n```\n\n### re.findall()\n```python\n# Find all occurrences\namounts = re.findall(r'\\d+\\.\\d{2}', text)\n# Returns: ['12.50', '3.99', '45.00']\n```\n\n### re.sub()\n```python\n# Replace patterns\nclean_text = re.sub(r'[^\\d.]', '', \"RM 1,234.56\")\n# Result: '1234.56'\n```\n\n## Flags\n```python\n# Case insensitive\nre.search(r'total', text, re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Multiline mode\nre.search(r'^TOTAL', text, re.MULTILINE)\n\n# Dot matches newline\nre.search(r'TOTAL.*?(\\d+)', text, re.DOTALL)\n```\n\n## Best Practices for Receipt Parsing\n\n### Extract Total Amount\n```python\ndef extract_total(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract total amount from receipt text\"\"\"\n    # Try different patterns in priority order\n    patterns = [\n        r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL[:\\s]*RM?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL\\s+RM[:\\s]*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT[:\\s]*RM?\\s*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n        r'TOTAL[:\\s]*(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)',\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in patterns:\n        match = re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)\n        if match:\n            amount = match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n            return float(amount)\n\n    return None\n```\n\n### Extract Date\n```python\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract date from receipt text\"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    patterns = [\n        r'(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})',  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in patterns:\n        match = re.search(pattern, text)\n        if match:\n            return match.group(0)\n\n    return None\n```\n\n## Special Characters\n- `.` - Any character\n- `*` - Zero or more\n- `+` - One or more\n- `?` - Zero or one (also makes quantifiers non-greedy)\n- `\\d` - Digit [0-9]\n- `\\s` - Whitespace\n- `\\w` - Word character [a-zA-Z0-9_]\n- `[]` - Character class\n- `()` - Capture group\n- `(?:)` - Non-capturing group\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_01MidKsNLpnozppehaXYY1Qi","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /app/workspace/environment/skills/openpyxl-excel.md"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"87d5c32a-3f3a-4210-835c-8b70ccc0f099","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/openpyxl-excel.md","content":"# OpenPyXL - Excel File Operations\n\n## Overview\nOpenPyXL is a Python library for reading and writing Excel 2010 xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm files. It provides comprehensive Excel manipulation capabilities without requiring Microsoft Excel.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\npip install openpyxl\n```\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Creating a New Workbook\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n# Create workbook\nwb = Workbook()\n\n# Get active sheet\nws = wb.active\n\n# Set sheet title\nws.title = \"results\"\n\n# Write data to cells\nws['A1'] = 'Name'\nws['B1'] = 'Age'\nws['C1'] = 'City'\n\n# Or use row/column notation (1-indexed)\nws.cell(row=2, column=1, value='Alice')\nws.cell(row=2, column=2, value=30)\nws.cell(row=2, column=3, value='New York')\n\n# Save workbook\nwb.save('output.xlsx')\n```\n\n### Writing Multiple Rows\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\nwb = Workbook()\nws = wb.active\n\n# Write header\nheaders = ['filename', 'date', 'total_amount']\nws.append(headers)\n\n# Write data rows\ndata = [\n    ['001.jpg', '2024-01-15', '45.50'],\n    ['002.jpg', '2024-01-16', '123.75'],\n    ['003.jpg', None, None],  # Null values\n]\n\nfor row in data:\n    ws.append(row)\n\nwb.save('results.xlsx')\n```\n\n### Reading Excel Files\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import load_workbook\n\n# Load existing workbook\nwb = load_workbook('input.xlsx')\n\n# Get sheet by name\nws = wb['Sheet1']\n\n# Read cell value\nvalue = ws['A1'].value\n\n# Iterate through rows\nfor row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):\n    filename, date, amount = row\n    print(f\"{filename}: {amount}\")\n```\n\n## Working with Sheets\n\n### Create/Delete Sheets\n```python\n# Create new sheet\nws1 = wb.create_sheet(\"Sheet2\")\n\n# Create at specific position\nws2 = wb.create_sheet(\"Sheet3\", 0)  # Insert at beginning\n\n# Delete sheet\ndel wb[\"Sheet3\"]\n\n# Get all sheet names\nprint(wb.sheetnames)\n```\n\n### Accessing Sheets\n```python\n# By name\nws = wb[\"results\"]\n\n# Active sheet\nws = wb.active\n\n# By index\nws = wb.worksheets[0]\n```\n\n## Data Types and Formatting\n\n### Writing Different Data Types\n```python\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nws['A1'] = 'Text'\nws['B1'] = 123  # Integer\nws['C1'] = 45.67  # Float\nws['D1'] = datetime.now()  # DateTime\nws['E1'] = True  # Boolean\nws['F1'] = None  # Null\n```\n\n### Number Formatting\n```python\nfrom openpyxl.styles import numbers\n\n# Format as currency\nws['A1'] = 45.50\nws['A1'].number_format = '\"$\"#,##0.00'\n\n# Format as percentage\nws['B1'] = 0.85\nws['B1'].number_format = '0.00%'\n\n# Custom format\nws['C1'].number_format = '0.00'\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### Efficient Row Writing\n```python\n# Efficient: Use append for multiple rows\ndata = [\n    ['row1_col1', 'row1_col2'],\n    ['row2_col1', 'row2_col2'],\n]\nfor row in data:\n    ws.append(row)\n\n# Less efficient: Individual cell writes\n# ws.cell(row=1, column=1, value='data')\n```\n\n### Handling Null Values\n```python\n# OpenPyXL handles None as empty cell\nws.append(['filename.jpg', None, '45.50'])\n# Result: filename.jpg | (empty) | 45.50\n```\n\n### Creating Clean Workbooks\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n# Create new workbook\nwb = Workbook()\n\n# Remove default sheet if needed\nif 'Sheet' in wb.sheetnames:\n    del wb['Sheet']\n\n# Create your sheet\nws = wb.create_sheet('results', 0)\n\n# Write data\nws.append(['Column1', 'Column2'])\n\nwb.save('clean_output.xlsx')\n```\n\n## Complete Example: Receipt Data to Excel\n\n```python\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\ndef save_receipts_to_excel(data, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        data: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_data = sorted(data, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_data:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n\n# Usage\nresults = [\n    {'filename': '001.jpg', 'date': '2024-01-15', 'total_amount': '45.50'},\n    {'filename': '002.jpg', 'date': '2024-01-16', 'total_amount': '123.00'},\n]\nsave_receipts_to_excel(results, 'output.xlsx')\n```\n\n## Common Gotchas\n1. Rows and columns are 1-indexed, not 0-indexed\n2. Always call `wb.save()` to persist changes\n3. Sheet names are case-sensitive\n4. Use `append()` for performance when writing many rows\n5. None values become empty cells\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_017VzHCDvphcb9sX3upqiddu","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /app/workspace/environment/skills/datetime-parsing.md"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"ad77779e-e51e-4e44-929d-81ba9ab9df90","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/datetime-parsing.md","content":"# DateTime Parsing and Formatting\n\n## Overview\nPython's datetime module provides classes for manipulating dates and times. Essential for parsing various date formats and converting them to standard formats like ISO 8601.\n\n## Installation\n```python\n# Built-in module, no installation needed\nfrom datetime import datetime, date\n```\n\n## Parsing Dates\n\n### Using datetime.strptime()\n```python\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Parse specific format\ndate_str = \"25/01/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d/%m/%Y\")\n\n# Convert to ISO format\niso_date = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n# Result: \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### Common Format Codes\n- `%d` - Day of month (01-31)\n- `%m` - Month (01-12)\n- `%Y` - Year (4 digits)\n- `%y` - Year (2 digits)\n- `%B` - Full month name (January)\n- `%b` - Abbreviated month name (Jan)\n- `%A` - Full weekday name (Monday)\n- `%a` - Abbreviated weekday name (Mon)\n- `%H` - Hour 24-hour (00-23)\n- `%I` - Hour 12-hour (01-12)\n- `%M` - Minute (00-59)\n- `%S` - Second (00-59)\n- `%p` - AM/PM\n\n## Common Date Formats\n\n### DD/MM/YYYY\n```python\ndate_str = \"25/01/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d/%m/%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### DD-MM-YYYY\n```python\ndate_str = \"25-01-2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%d-%m-%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### MM/DD/YYYY (US format)\n```python\ndate_str = \"01/25/2024\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%m/%d/%Y\")\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n### YYYY-MM-DD (ISO format)\n```python\ndate_str = \"2024-01-25\"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n# Already in ISO format\n```\n\n## Handling Multiple Formats\n\n### Try Multiple Patterns\n```python\ndef parse_date_flexible(date_str):\n    \"\"\"Try to parse date string with multiple formats\"\"\"\n    formats = [\n        \"%d/%m/%Y\",      # 25/01/2024\n        \"%d-%m-%Y\",      # 25-01-2024\n        \"%Y-%m-%d\",      # 2024-01-25\n        \"%m/%d/%Y\",      # 01/25/2024\n        \"%d %b %Y\",      # 25 Jan 2024\n        \"%d %B %Y\",      # 25 January 2024\n        \"%B %d, %Y\",     # January 25, 2024\n    ]\n\n    for fmt in formats:\n        try:\n            return datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n\n    return None  # No format matched\n```\n\n### Convert to ISO Format\n```python\ndef to_iso_date(date_str):\n    \"\"\"Convert various date formats to ISO YYYY-MM-DD\"\"\"\n    date_obj = parse_date_flexible(date_str)\n    if date_obj:\n        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    return None\n```\n\n## Date Validation\n\n### Check Valid Date\n```python\ndef is_valid_date(date_str, format_str=\"%d/%m/%Y\"):\n    \"\"\"Check if string is a valid date\"\"\"\n    try:\n        datetime.strptime(date_str, format_str)\n        return True\n    except ValueError:\n        return False\n```\n\n### Handle Edge Cases\n```python\n# Invalid date\ntry:\n    datetime.strptime(\"31/02/2024\", \"%d/%m/%Y\")\nexcept ValueError as e:\n    print(\"Invalid date\")  # February doesn't have 31 days\n```\n\n## Formatting Dates\n\n### Standard Formats\n```python\ndate_obj = datetime(2024, 1, 25)\n\n# ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)\niso = date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")  # \"2024-01-25\"\n\n# US format (MM/DD/YYYY)\nus = date_obj.strftime(\"%m/%d/%Y\")   # \"01/25/2024\"\n\n# European format (DD/MM/YYYY)\neu = date_obj.strftime(\"%d/%m/%Y\")   # \"25/01/2024\"\n\n# Long format\nlong = date_obj.strftime(\"%B %d, %Y\")  # \"January 25, 2024\"\n```\n\n## Receipt Date Extraction Example\n\n```python\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\ndef extract_and_format_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt OCR text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Find date pattern\n    date_pattern = r'\\d{2}[/-]\\d{2}[/-]\\d{4}'\n    match = re.search(date_pattern, text)\n\n    if not match:\n        return None\n\n    date_str = match.group(0)\n\n    # Try different formats\n    formats = [\n        \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n        \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n        \"%m/%d/%Y\",\n        \"%m-%d-%Y\",\n    ]\n\n    for fmt in formats:\n        try:\n            date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n            # Convert to ISO format\n            return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n\n    return None\n\n# Usage\nocr_text = \"Date: 25/01/2024\\nTotal: RM 45.50\"\niso_date = extract_and_format_date(ocr_text)\nprint(iso_date)  # \"2024-01-25\"\n```\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always validate dates** before formatting\n2. **Use try-except** when parsing unknown formats\n3. **Store dates in ISO format** for consistency\n4. **Be aware of locale** (US vs European date formats)\n5. **Handle timezone** if needed (use `pytz` or `zoneinfo`)\n\n## Common Pitfalls\n\n```python\n# Ambiguous dates\ndate_str = \"01/02/2024\"\n# Is this January 2nd or February 1st?\n# Always clarify the expected format\n\n# Two-digit years\ndatetime.strptime(\"25/01/24\", \"%d/%m/%y\")  # Assumes 2024, not 1924\n\n# Whitespace\ndate_str = \" 25/01/2024 \"\ndate_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str.strip(), \"%d/%m/%Y\")  # Always strip\n```\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}
{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_017HW9814PMhLa3uWnYB4Exx","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /app/workspace/environment/skills/pillow-image-processing.md"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"887faa5a-91c3-486a-9a06-510f37ae1dcf","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/app/workspace/environment/skills/pillow-image-processing.md","content":"# Pillow (PIL) - Image Processing\n\n## Overview\nPillow is the friendly PIL (Python Imaging Library) fork. It provides extensive file format support and powerful image processing capabilities, essential for preprocessing images before OCR.\n\n## Installation\n```bash\npip install Pillow\n```\n\n## Basic Image Operations\n\n### Opening and Saving Images\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image\n\n# Open image\nimg = Image.open('input.jpg')\n\n# Save image\nimg.save('output.png')\n\n# Save with quality\nimg.save('output.jpg', quality=95)\n```\n\n### Image Information\n```python\n# Get image properties\nprint(img.size)      # (width, height)\nprint(img.format)    # 'JPEG', 'PNG', etc.\nprint(img.mode)      # 'RGB', 'L' (grayscale), etc.\n\n# Check dimensions\nwidth, height = img.size\n```\n\n## Image Preprocessing for OCR\n\n### Convert to Grayscale\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nimg = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Convert to grayscale\ngray_img = img.convert('L')\ngray_img.save('gray_receipt.jpg')\n```\n\n### Enhance Contrast\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance\n\nimg = Image.open('receipt.jpg')\n\n# Increase contrast\nenhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\nenhanced_img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)  # 1.0 is original, >1.0 increases contrast\n```\n\n### Adjust Brightness\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageEnhance\n\nenhancer = ImageEnhance.Brightness(img)\nbrighter_img = enhancer.enhance(1.5)  # 1.5x brighter\n```\n\n### Sharpen Image\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageFilter\n\n# Apply sharpening filter\nsharpened = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n# Or unsharp mask for more control\nsharpened = img.filter(ImageFilter.UnsharpMask(radius=2, percent=150))\n```\n\n### Resize Image\n```python\n# Resize to specific dimensions\nnew_size = (800, 600)\nresized = img.resize(new_size)\n\n# Resize maintaining aspect ratio\nimg.thumbnail((800, 800))  # Max dimensions, maintains ratio\n```\n\n### Rotate Image\n```python\n# Rotate by angle (counter-clockwise)\nrotated = img.rotate(90, expand=True)  # expand=True adjusts canvas size\n\n# Auto-rotate based on EXIF\nfrom PIL import ImageOps\ncorrected = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img)\n```\n\n## Complete Preprocessing Pipeline\n\n### For Receipt OCR\n```python\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\n\ndef preprocess_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    # Open image\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    # Optional: Apply threshold for black & white\n    # img = img.point(lambda x: 0 if x < 128 else 255, '1')\n\n    return img\n\n# Usage with pytesseract\nimport pytesseract\n\npreprocessed = preprocess_receipt('receipt.jpg')\ntext = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed)\n```\n\n## Image Filters\n\n### Common Filters\n```python\nfrom PIL import ImageFilter\n\n# Blur\nblurred = img.filter(ImageFilter.BLUR)\n\n# Gaussian blur\ngaussian = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=2))\n\n# Edge detection\nedges = img.filter(ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES)\n\n# Smooth\nsmooth = img.filter(ImageFilter.SMOOTH)\n\n# Detail enhancement\ndetail = img.filter(ImageFilter.DETAIL)\n```\n\n## Working with Image Regions\n\n### Crop Image\n```python\n# Define box (left, top, right, bottom)\nbox = (100, 100, 400, 400)\ncropped = img.crop(box)\n```\n\n### Paste Image\n```python\n# Paste one image onto another\nbackground.paste(foreground, (x, y))\n```\n\n## Color Modes\n\n### Common Modes\n- `'1'` - 1-bit pixels, black and white\n- `'L'` - 8-bit pixels, grayscale\n- `'RGB'` - 3x8-bit pixels, true color\n- `'RGBA'` - 4x8-bit pixels, true color with transparency\n- `'CMYK'` - 4x8-bit pixels, color separation\n\n### Convert Between Modes\n```python\n# RGB to grayscale\ngray = rgb_img.convert('L')\n\n# Grayscale to RGB\nrgb = gray_img.convert('RGB')\n\n# To black & white (binary)\nbw = img.convert('1')\n```\n\n## File Format Handling\n\n### Read Different Formats\n```python\n# Pillow supports many formats\njpg_img = Image.open('image.jpg')\npng_img = Image.open('image.png')\nbmp_img = Image.open('image.bmp')\ntiff_img = Image.open('image.tiff')\n```\n\n### List All Files in Directory\n```python\nimport os\nfrom PIL import Image\n\ndef process_all_images(directory):\n    \"\"\"Process all images in directory\"\"\"\n    for filename in os.listdir(directory):\n        if filename.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')):\n            img_path = os.path.join(directory, filename)\n            img = Image.open(img_path)\n            # Process image...\n```\n\n## Best Practices for OCR Preprocessing\n\n1. **Convert to grayscale** - Reduces complexity, improves OCR accuracy\n2. **Increase contrast** - Makes text more distinguishable from background\n3. **Sharpen** - Clarifies text edges\n4. **Resize appropriately** - Too small reduces accuracy, too large slows processing\n5. **Remove noise** - Use filters to clean up image\n6. **Correct orientation** - Ensure text is horizontal\n\n## Memory Management\n\n```python\n# Close image when done\nimg.close()\n\n# Or use context manager\nwith Image.open('image.jpg') as img:\n    # Process image\n    processed = img.convert('L')\n# Image automatically closed\n```\n\n## Common Gotchas\n\n1. **Modification creates new image** - Most operations return new Image object\n2. **File formats have limitations** - JPEG doesn't support transparency\n3. **Color mode matters** - Some operations require specific modes\n4. **Filter order matters** - Apply filters in optimal sequence\n5. **EXIF data** - Remember to handle image rotation from EXIF\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_vrtx_01GdZ4UF1nff1KBKzgMXYgbs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_0191GVkbUknuTyr7VSCiXWWP","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/process_receipts.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern consists of (keyword_pattern, amount_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: TOTAL / AMOUNT / TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE / NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 4),\n        (r'\\bTOTAL\\b', 4),\n        (r'\\bAMOUNT\\b', 4),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    amount_pattern = r'(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper()\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        if any(excl in line_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, lines[i + 1])\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                        best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                        best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1252,"cache_read_input_tokens":29027,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1252,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"dc8e3554-bb26-448c-83ea-e944890ba6b7"}

Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null}}

Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:RM\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1455,"cache_read_input_tokens":35433,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1455,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"72dc4a3c-b734-4f58-99cd-ce6887260fde","uuid":"0f7d0755-ad6c-4356-b4eb-aebba7839f80"}

Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                        best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                        best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match","newString":"def extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:RM\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern consists of (keyword_pattern, amount_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: TOTAL / AMOUNT / TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE / NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 4),\n        (r'\\bTOTAL\\b', 4),\n        (r'\\bAMOUNT\\b', 4),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    amount_pattern = r'(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d{2})?)'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper()\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        if any(excl in line_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, lines[i + 1])\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                        best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                        best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":121,"oldLines":59,"newStart":121,"newLines":86,"lines":["     #
