Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:RM\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'","newString":"    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:RM\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":149,"oldLines":7,"newStart":149,"newLines":8,"lines":[" ","     # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)","     # Must have decimal point for better accuracy","-    amount_pattern = r'(?:RM\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'","+    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.","+    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'"," ","     best_match = None","     best_priority = 999"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',   # DD/MM/YY or DD-MM-YY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n                \"%d/%m/%y\",  # 2-digit year\n                \"%d-%m-%y\",  # 2-digit year\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',   # DD/MM/YY or DD-MM-YY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n                \"%d/%m/%y\",  # 2-digit year\n                \"%d-%m-%y\",  # 2-digit year\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":153,"oldLines":7,"newStart":153,"newLines":8,"lines":["     # as it's more likely to be better\n        total_count_preprocessed = text_preprocessed.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_preprocessed.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n        total_count_raw = text_raw.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_raw.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n\n        if total_count_raw > total_count_preprocessed:\n            return text_raw\n        else:\n            return text_preprocessed\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        # Use config optimized for receipts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',   # DD/MM/YY or DD-MM-YY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n                \"%d/%m/%y\",  # 2-digit year\n                \"%d-%m-%y\",  # 2-digit year\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    # Also handle spaces in numbers like \"86. 00\"\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=\\(]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.?\\s*\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    # Remove commas and spaces from the amount\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '').replace(' ', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":57,"oldLines":11,"newStart":57,"newLines":27,"lines":["         Extracted text as string","     \"\"\"","     try:","-        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)","-        # For 2-digit years, Python defaults to 1900-1999 for 00-68 and 2000-2068 for 69-99\n                    # We want all 2-digit years to be 2000-2099, so adjust if year < 2000\n                    if date_obj.year < 2000:\n                        # Extract the 2-digit year and add 2000\n                        if '%y' in fmt:\n                            date_obj = date_obj.replace(year=date_obj.year + 100)\n\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        # Try both with and without preprocessing\n        # Sometimes preprocessing helps, sometimes it hurts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n\n        # Try with preprocessing\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        text_preprocessed = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n\n        # Try without preprocessing\n        img = Image.open(image_path)\n        text_raw = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, config=custom_config)\n\n        # Use the one with more \"TOTAL\" or \"AMOUNT\" keywords\n        # as it's more likely to be better\n        total_count_preprocessed = text_preprocessed.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_preprocessed.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n        total_count_raw = text_raw.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_raw.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n\n        if total_count_raw > total_count_preprocessed:\n            return text_raw\n        else:\n            return text_preprocessed\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',   # DD/MM/YY or DD-MM-YY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n                \"%d/%m/%y\",  # 2-digit year\n                \"%d-%m-%y\",  # 2-digit year\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    # Also handle spaces in numbers like \"86. 00\"\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=\\(]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.?\\s*\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    # Remove commas and spaces from the amount\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '').replace(' ', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    # Extract text using OCR\n    text = extract_text_from_image(image_path)\n\n    # Extract date and total amount\n    date = extract_date(text)\n    total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n    return {\n        'filename': filename,\n        'date': date,\n        'total_amount': total_amount\n    }\n\n\ndef process_all_receipts(input_dir):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process all receipt images in the input directory.\n\n    Args:\n        input_dir: Directory containing receipt images\n\n    Returns:\n        List of dictionaries with extraction results\n    \"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get all image files\n    image_files = [\n        f for f in os.listdir(input_dir)\n        if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))\n    ]\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    image_files.sort()\n\n    print(f\"Processing {len(image_files)} receipt images...\")\n\n    for filename in image_files:\n        image_path = os.path.join(input_dir, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        result = process_receipt(image_path)\n        results.append(result)\n\n    return results\n\n\ndef save_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Save receipt data to Excel file.\n\n    Args:\n        results: List of dicts with keys: filename, date, total_amount\n        output_path: Path to save Excel file\n    \"\"\"\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write headers\n    ws.append(['filename', 'date', 'total_amount'])\n\n    # Sort by filename\n    sorted_results = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['filename'])\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for item in sorted_results:\n        ws.append([\n            item['filename'],\n            item['date'],\n            item['total_amount']\n        ])\n\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results saved to {output_path}\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    \"\"\"Main function to process receipts and generate Excel file.\"\"\"\n    input_dir = '/app/workspace/dataset/img'\n    output_path = '/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx'\n\n    # Process all receipts\n    results = process_all_receipts(input_dir)\n\n    # Save to Excel\n    save_to_excel(results, output_path)\n\n    # Print summary\n    print(\"\\nSummary:\")\n    print(f\"Total receipts processed: {len(results)}\")\n    successful_dates = sum(1 for r in results if r['date'] is not None)\n    successful_amounts = sum(1 for r in results if r['total_amount'] is not None)\n    print(f\"Dates extracted: {successful_dates}/{len(results)}\")\n    print(f\"Amounts extracted: {successful_amounts}/{len(results)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":118,"oldLines":6,"newStart":118,"newLines":13,"lines":["             for fmt in formats:","                 try:","                     date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)","+                    # Extract the 2-digit year and add 2000","+                        if '%y' in fmt:","+                            date_obj = date_obj.replace(year=date_obj.year + 100)","+","                     # Sanity check: year should be reasonable","                     if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:","                         return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

Priority 7: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 7),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 7),\n    ]","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nReceipt OCR Processing Script\n\nReads receipt images, extracts date and total amount using OCR,\nand saves results to an Excel file.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageEnhance, ImageFilter\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\n\n\ndef preprocess_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Preprocess receipt image for optimal OCR results.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to input image\n\n    Returns:\n        Preprocessed PIL Image object\n    \"\"\"\n    img = Image.open(image_path)\n\n    # Convert to grayscale\n    img = img.convert('L')\n\n    # Resize if too small (OCR works better with larger images)\n    width, height = img.size\n    if width < 1000:\n        scale = 1000 / width\n        new_size = (int(width * scale), int(height * scale))\n        img = img.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)\n\n    # Enhance contrast\n    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)\n    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)\n\n    # Sharpen\n    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract text from receipt image using OCR.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Extracted text as string\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        # Try both with and without preprocessing\n        # Sometimes preprocessing helps, sometimes it hurts\n        custom_config = r'--oem 3 --psm 6'\n\n        # Try with preprocessing\n        preprocessed = preprocess_image(image_path)\n        text_preprocessed = pytesseract.image_to_string(preprocessed, config=custom_config)\n\n        # Try without preprocessing\n        img = Image.open(image_path)\n        text_raw = pytesseract.image_to_string(img, config=custom_config)\n\n        # Use the one with more \"TOTAL\" or \"AMOUNT\" keywords\n        # as it's more likely to be better\n        total_count_preprocessed = text_preprocessed.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_preprocessed.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n        total_count_raw = text_raw.upper().count('TOTAL') + text_raw.upper().count('AMOUNT')\n\n        if total_count_raw > total_count_preprocessed:\n            return text_raw\n        else:\n            return text_preprocessed\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error processing {image_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        ISO formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD) or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Common date patterns\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{4})\\b',  # DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'\\b(\\d{4})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',  # YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD\n        r'\\b(\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})[/-](\\d{2})\\b',   # DD/MM/YY or DD-MM-YY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.finditer(pattern, text)\n        for match in matches:\n            date_str = match.group(0)\n\n            # Try different format interpretations\n            formats = [\n                \"%d/%m/%Y\",\n                \"%d-%m-%Y\",\n                \"%Y-%m-%d\",\n                \"%Y/%m/%d\",\n                \"%d/%m/%y\",  # 2-digit year\n                \"%d-%m-%y\",  # 2-digit year\n            ]\n\n            for fmt in formats:\n                try:\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)\n                    # For 2-digit years, Python defaults to 1900-1999 for 00-68 and 2000-2068 for 69-99\n                    # We want all 2-digit years to be 2000-2099, so adjust if year < 2000\n                    if date_obj.year < 2000:\n                        # Extract the 2-digit year and add 2000\n                        if '%y' in fmt:\n                            date_obj = date_obj.replace(year=date_obj.year + 100)\n\n                    # Sanity check: year should be reasonable\n                    if 2000 <= date_obj.year <= 2030:\n                        return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n\n    return None\n\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"\n    Extract total amount from receipt text following priority rules.\n\n    Args:\n        text: OCR extracted text from receipt\n\n    Returns:\n        Total amount as string with 2 decimal places, or None\n    \"\"\"\n    # Exclusion keywords - lines containing these should be skipped\n    exclusion_keywords = [\n        'SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST',\n        'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'CASH', 'TENDERED'\n    ]\n\n    # Split text into lines\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority patterns (from most to least specific)\n    # Each pattern: (keyword_pattern, priority)\n    patterns = [\n        # Priority 1: GRAND TOTAL\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        # Priority 2: TOTAL RM / TOTAL: RM\n        (r'TOTAL\\s*:?\\s*RM', 2),\n        # Priority 2.5: Total Rounded\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+ROUNDED', 2),\n        # Priority 3: TOTAL AMOUNT\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        # Priority 4: NETT TOTAL / NET TOTAL\n        (r'(?:NETT?|NET)\\s+TOTAL', 4),\n        # Priority 5: TOTAL DUE / AMOUNT DUE / BALANCE DUE\n        (r'(?:TOTAL|AMOUNT|BALANCE)\\s+DUE', 5),\n        # Priority 6: Standalone TOTAL or AMOUNT\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*TOTAL[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n        (r'^[^A-Z]*AMOUNT[^A-Z]*$', 6),\n    ]\n\n    # Amount pattern to extract numbers (with optional comma separators)\n    # Must have decimal point for better accuracy\n    # Handle OCR errors where RM might be read as RH, Ri, etc.\n    # Also handle spaces in numbers like \"86. 00\"\n    amount_pattern = r'(?:R[MHI]\\s*[:=\\(]?\\s*)?(\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})*\\.?\\s*\\d{2})'\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = 999\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        line_upper = line.upper().strip()\n\n        # Skip empty lines\n        if not line_upper:\n            continue\n\n        # Skip lines with exclusion keywords\n        skip = False\n        for excl in exclusion_keywords:\n            if excl in line_upper:\n                # Special case: \"CASH TENDERED\" should be skipped, but \"TOTAL\" alone is ok\n                if excl in ['CASH', 'TENDERED']:\n                    if 'CASH' in line_upper and 'TENDERED' in line_upper:\n                        skip = True\n                        break\n                else:\n                    skip = True\n                    break\n\n        if skip:\n            continue\n\n        # Try each pattern\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in patterns:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Found keyword, now look for amount\n                # First try on same line (after the keyword)\n                amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, line)\n\n                # If no amount on same line, check next line\n                if not amount_match and i + 1 < len(lines):\n                    next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                    # Only check next line if it doesn't contain exclusion keywords\n                    next_upper = next_line.upper()\n                    if not any(excl in next_upper for excl in exclusion_keywords):\n                        amount_match = re.search(amount_pattern, next_line)\n\n                if amount_match and priority < best_priority:\n                    # Remove commas and spaces from the amount\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '').replace(' ', '')\n                    try:\n                        amount_float = float(amount_str)\n                        # Sanity check: amount should be reasonable (0.01 to 100000)\n                        if 0.01 <= amount_float <= 100000:\n                            # Format with exactly 2 decimal places\n                            best_match = f\"{amount_float:.2f}\"\n                            best_priority = priority\n                    except ValueError:\n                        continue\n\n    return best_match\n\n\ndef process_receipt(image_path):\n    \"\"\"\n    Process a single receipt image and extract date and total amount.\n\n    Args:\n        image_path: Path to receipt image\n\n    Returns:\n        Dictionary with filename, date, and total_amount\n    \"\"\"\n    filename = os.path.basename(image_path)\n\n    #
